Heard Shri Janardan Singh, the learned counsel for the applicants, Shri Amitesh Pratap Singh,
learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Shri Diwakar Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State-opposite party no.1 and perused the record.

The instant application under section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants, namely, Dayawati Yadav and Sarvendra Singh Yadav with the prayer to quash the impugned chargesheet dated 01.10.2022 arising out of case crime no. 226 of 2021 under sections 498A,323,504,506 IPC and section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act , Police Station Mahanagar, District Lucknow and impugned cognizance order dated 14.10.20222 passed by Special Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate CBI (U.P.), Lucknow in Case No. 94702 of 2022.

sentences.text: In compliance of this Court's order dated 21.02.2023 applicant no.2-Sarvendra Singh Yadav, his elder brothers namely Mahendra and Santosh and opposite party no.2-Jyoti Yadav are present in person before this Court.
They have been identified by their respective counsels.

Shri Mahendra and Shri Santosh, who are elder brothers of applicant no.2-Sarvendra Singh Yadav,
submitted before this Court that they will not interfere in the matrimonial life of Sarvendra Singh Yadav and Jyoti Yadav and they are free to live happily in the house.
They further submitted that they never interferred at any time in the life of Sarvendra Singh Yadav and Jyoti Yadav.
Applicant No.2-Sarvendra Singh Yadav submitted before this Court that he is ready to keep his wife Jyoti Yadav with him.

Opposite party no.2-Jyoti Yadav submitted before this Court that she is read to go to her matrimonial house today i.e. 22.03.2023 at 5.00 P.M. Sarvendra Singh Yadav, Mahendra and Santosh will take Jyoti Yadav from her parental house today i.e. 22.03.2023 at 5.00 P.M. Opposite party no.2-Smt. Jyoti Yadav is allowed to use the house hold items which she got as gift.

All the expenditure of Smt. Jyoti Yadav will be born by her husband Sarvendra Singh Yadav including food,
cloths and other requirements as desired by her.
The matter has been resolved between the parties.
It is a simple matrimonial dispute regarding some ego problem.
The problem is not so serious.
Both the parties are agreed to withdraw the cases whatsoever filed against each other and their family family members also within one week from today.
Learned counsel for the parties have no objection if the proceedings of case pending before court below are quashed.
The present 482 Cr.P.C. application stands allowed.

Keeping in view the statements made by the parties and arguments as advanced by the learned for the parties and the observation made herein above, the impugned chargesheet dated 01.10.2022 arising out of case crime no. 226 of 2021 under sections 498A,323,504,506 IPC and section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mahanagar,
District Lucknow and impugned cognizance order dated 14.10.20222 passed by Special Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate CBI (U.P.), Lucknow in Case No. 94702 of 2022 are hereby quashed.
